native.binding: Exact original general-map class; initialization, ordered incidence learning, native sparse propagation, ELU, residual/epsilon update, log-softmax head.
All required constructor args; plain graph/time tensors, no model-level reset; native map/other parameter grouping and graph-update method.
Native SheafLearner .L is detached; one bias-free LocalConcatSheafLearner(2c,d²), ordered endpoints then tanh.
Immutable graph/index preprocessing belongs to each distinct builder module; static tensors can be shared by identity.

Native full general Laplacian; F.TF degree sums, -F_left.TF_right lower block; augmented block inverse square root/SVD, training jitter, clamping and final sparse assembly. Saved trans_maps is unnormalized.
Directed-edge dictionary requires unique nonloop edges and exactly one reverse. Caller order is retained by adapter.
Author SVD matrix-power implementation retained byte-for-byte; no numerical execution.
Original own-task objective is NLL and optimizer separates sheaf/other decay. TEST is evaluated each epoch and test can affect continuation, so this runner is not approved for the future protocol.
Defaults .01 LR, .0005 decay, d2,L2,f20, both feature maps, block normalization and tanh; paper/config choices are kept distinct.
Original dependency anchor: Python3.9.9, Torch1.11.0, PyG2.0.4, torch-householder1.0.1.

adapter.SharedBELinear: Shares exact original W/b, learns private r/s; unit initialization; bias outside scale. Numerical parity gate unrun.
adapter.SharedNativeBank: One native constructor, distinct deepcopied modules/builders, shared native parameters plus immutable topology, private factors and native per-member draws, full M forwards. Map/other optimizer groups deduplicated.
adapter.IndependentNativeBank: M fresh complete source constructors, learned object-identity disjointness check, native per-member optimizer groups; future caller must apply independent prospective seed streams.
adapter.AssignedIncidences: Paired lower/reverse incidence reassignment before unchanged original normalization; fixed saved buffer or one RNG draw each forward; static graph identity/version bound.
adapter.LayerSharedIncidence: One full trainable tanh matrix per member/layer, repeated on all ordered incidences; original NSD has one ordered learner, not DNSD two builders.
adapter.NodeCapacityRight: Private node-only bias-free residual adapter before original right feature map; exact removed map-path count at M4,d2/d4; nonlinear control is ours.
adapter.JointMultiTransportSingle: Captures live pre-native-head node state by hook, joint nonlinear head with own NLL; native heads frozen, still computed; full transport path and extra readout cost charged.

config: paper_config/NSD_CONFIG_SCOPE.json and PUBLISHED_RANGES.json bind the AppendixE/Table2 extraction; PROTOCOL.json labels four configurations and fixed tolerances as ours.

bounded_semantic_findings: scalar graph-degree normalization differs from original block-degree NSD
default embedding LayerNorm differs from paper stalkwise normalization
dnsd_exclusion.scope: Previously inspected tree/README/models/config; metadata and retrieval hashes retained. No source code adapted.

claim_limit: No matrix-transport novelty, numerical parity, baseline competence or performance/cost claim follows from source inspection.
